browser.text:
Completed the focused pass on the actual Expo host, without using the shared API proxy, editing code, or submitting a Practice answer.

- **390px female-reproductive, 1× behavior:** A trusted Chromium CDP touch swipe on a non-marker picture region moved the actual nearest `overflow:auto` parent from `scrollTop` 527 to 422 (−105px); canvas stayed centered at scale 1 and Recall labels stayed hidden.
- **Pinch and zoomed pan:** With a fixed centroid at (195,611), increasing two-finger separation 80→110→140→170px rendered scales **1→1.375→1.75→2.125**, while parent `scrollTop` stayed 422 throughout the samples. At 2.125×, horizontal, vertical, and diagonal drags changed canvas translation (ending at +90,+90) without moving that parent. A drag starting on a Recall marker moved the canvas +36px and left it unrevealed. A 3px-jitter tap at (185,480), inside the visible marker hit area but outside its glyph, revealed the correct **Uterus** structure; Markers 1 and 17 both changed because the app shares reveal state by structure ID. Parent scroll stayed 422.
- **Touch-count transition, bounds, reset:** Pinching back to 1× produced zero translation without a jump through the two-to-one transition. On the 390px route, parent scroll was 422 at last release; a fresh 1× swipe then moved it to 287. Additional pinch samples clamped at **4×** and **1×**. Extreme pan at 4× was bounded at (+195,+87). I used the source’s 1450×1000 aspect and the 348×676 viewer’s `contain` fit (actual picture **348×240**, letterboxed vertically), not the full DOM image bounds; the extreme position retained about 25% of the contained picture width in-frame. Repeated UI zoom followed by pan and Reset returned exactly to `translate(0,0) scale(1)`.
- **Controls and 320px enlarged skeletal fixture:** At 390px, Zoom in/out/Reset were outside the image and 44px high; document width equaled the 390px viewport. On `/module/skeletal-system?qaFontScale=2.5` at 320px, the real skull viewer panned at 1.5× by (−22,−20) with parent `scrollTop` fixed at 4583; tapping the visible Recall target revealed **Maxilla** without scrolling. Reset returned to centered 1×, and Learn↔Recall navigation still worked. Document width remained 320. No separate “Text Large” control was available; the supported query supplied the enlarged typography.
- **Practice marker:** Started the actual focused skeletal session on question 1/5 and did not submit. After panning the initially clipped-at-zoom target into the viewer, a drag starting on the real skull hotspot moved the canvas to (+35,+49.25) at 1.5×; the target remained unselected and **Submit answer stayed disabled**. The nearest parent remained at 610. A further 1.5→1× pinch and two-to-one transition kept that same parent at 610 at every recorded stage, including with one finger still down and after release; no answer was selected or submitted.

No functional gesture or accidental-selection issue was observed in this pass. At 320px with 2.5× typography, text wraps heavily and portions of the prompt can be outside the viewport while scrolling to the viewer; this is vertical presentation, not horizontal overflow. Evidence is browser-rendered web/CDP touch behavior, not proof from a physical native device. App content and offline-loading code were untouched; no files were changed.

practiceTapAndBoundsClarification.name: boneefied-bvr03-gestures

screenshots.description: Practice skull hotspot selected after the trusted sub-6px-jitter touch; orange outline is visible, with no submission.

practiceTapAndBoundsClarification.text:
On the existing focused Practice question (“Tap the skull in this anterior axial-skeleton view”), `hotspot-skull` was enabled (`disabled=false`). At 1.5×, after panning the target fully into the viewer, its transparent hitbox measured 37.08×53.25px. A trusted CDP touch from (173,238) to (175,240)—2.8px jitter, inside the hitbox and outside its transparent marker paint—selected the skull: the hotspot gained its orange selection outline and Submit changed from disabled to enabled. Canvas stayed at `translateX(0) translateY(45px) scale(1.5)` and the actual scroll parent stayed at `scrollTop=610`. Submit was not clicked; no answer was submitted.

The earlier extreme-pan offset (+195,+87) did **not** saturate the code bounds; it matched the largest physical drag used (the pointer moved +195,+87 from center). At scale 4 for the 348×676 frame with a contained 348×240 picture, the calculated allowable offset ranges are ±522px horizontally and ±649px vertically. No additional bounds test was run.
